_note: Domain-specific safety rules for the new medical/psychology/raga content added in this KB upgrade. These SUPPLEMENT config/governance_rules.json (12->14 core rules) and do not replace or override it. Proposed as a reviewable addendum -- see config/governance_addendum_proposed.json for the specific new rule text suggested for formal addition.

rules.title: No condition-to-raga auto-recommendation for serious conditions
rules.detail: Any raga associated with a serious_medical_condition or serious_psychiatric_condition flag (see raaga/structured/chakra_raga_bridge.json) must be excluded from automatic ranking/recommendation output until a clinical lead has reviewed and explicitly approved a framing that does not imply treatment or diagnosis.

rules.title: Traditional framework content is never restated as medical fact
rules.detail: LEVEL_4/5/6 content (chakra books, Ayurveda, raga-condition folklore) may only be surfaced with framing that makes its traditional/non-clinical status explicit to the therapist.

rules.title: Copyrighted trade books require licensing review before ingestion
rules.detail: Full commercial books/textbooks identified in source_registry/source_metadata.json as usage_review_required must not be embedded into the production vector store until licensing/fair-use status is confirmed. Short paraphrased summaries for internal reference are lower-risk than full-text chunking, but still require review.

rules.title: Medical context never implies chakra causation
rules.detail: Retrieval from medical/ domains (anatomy, physiology, neurology, DSM-5-TR, psychological disorders) may only inform contextual understanding of a patient's stated symptom. It must never be used to derive a chakra score directly -- that path runs only through the existing structured/symptom_to_chakra.json, emotion_to_chakra.json, behaviour_to_chakra.json files.
